scope: Existing original source frames only, no raster edits or new character depiction. Full native frames inspected at 1280x720; source enlargement adds no information.

observations.finding: Visible in both; broadly lobed pink crest retained.
Pale grey/lavender base and dark tip retained; pose changes projection.
Yellow cheek area, blue/mint head and body, pink chest/wing accents retained. Feather-by-feather geometry cannot be established.
Dark tips adjacent to pink wing areas retained; portions hidden by bunnies.
Visible feet grey in both, rather than the black talons rejected on the former solo page. Reclined/partly hidden legs cannot be judged against standing-leg proportions.
Two solid dust bunnies hold Eagle on page 17; two fading dust bunnies and cleaning sparkles on page 18. No blanket.

decision: Retain existing source frames. Do not generate a repair without a demonstrated visible defect. This review narrows uncertainty; it does not grant exact identity or owner acceptance.
